models.limits: Finite explicit-retrieve/display model, not React, DOM, AbortController, memory zeroization or implementation refinement. Only the successful response path is modeled; native store/IAM must authorize before returning any secret. A returned ARN can differ and must be rejected. Retrieve, Hide and navigation invalidate epochs; unmount also clears visible state. Parent must remount on region/principal changes. Emission history captures the context at each acceptance so later Hide/navigation cannot relabel an earlier stale acceptance. Draft entry, mutation atomicity and form layout are outside this model. Parent main.jsx scope binds only Secrets routing/remount key (region/principal/navigation); the generated app.js binding is the canonical compiled artifact of those source inputs, independently checked by bundle/asset hashes. It does not model unrelated existing console services or prove JavaScript compilation. Exact blob binding records scope, not semantic equivalence. For regenerated app.js, only the existing Secrets reveal epoch projection is bound; the new IAM UI is browser-tested and is not proven by that model.
